directory_policies.notes.2: GRE policy: GRE is optional for the on-campus MS; omitting scores does not harm the application.
directory_policies.notes.3: Preparation: The listed programming/computation and mathematics preparation admits individual deficiencies and alternative backgrounds; these remain manual rather than unconditional topic exclusions.

fact_summary: The on-campus MS instructions confirm optional GRE and an individual review of preparatory courses and minor deficiencies.
